purpose: Correct the missing controlled long-context coding evidence; keep prior results as exploratory evidence
pin: Preserve public function signatures, existing valid-input behavior, and test files. Keep the requested fix focused.
sampling_requirement: Use identical explicit sampling options when supported; preserve actual wire settings and server capability evidence. Do not silently rely on defaults.
pristine_reset: Copy archived pre-edit fixture files into a unique workspace per attempt, hash before starting; never reuse final workspaces.
history_requirement: Use sanitized genuine tool logs/task history with legitimate early constraints. Exclude target fixture solutions and arbitrary filler. Freeze and hash the history before any treatment outcomes.
context_target: Approximately 32K provider-reported input for the first coding-task request; record actual size and exclude wrong-band runs from 32K evidence.
capture: exact expected transformation and rule ledger
scope: No hosted calls, server changes, personal configuration edits, or optimization redesign.
